title: Approval of First Amendment to Agreement No. 47814 between the City of
text:
[N. Items for Approval]
Recommended by Office of the City Attorney
  Approval of First Amendment to Agreement No. 47814 between the City of
  Los Angeles, acting by and through the Los Angeles Department of
  Water and Power and Kaplan Kirsch, LLP. The Amendment adds $7,000,000
  for an amount not to exceed $8,600,000 and would extend the term of the
  Agreement by two years, making the termination date April 20, 2029.
  Determine item is exempt pursuant to CEQA Guidelines Section 15061(b)(3).
summary: Approve first amendment to legal services agreement with Kaplan Kirsch increasing contract by $7,000,000 to $8,600,000 and extending the term by two years to April 20, 2029.
